page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E2.4 is a general-purpose virtual machine shape built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 vCPUs derived from 4 dedicated AMD EPYC 7551 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled at two threads per core. The processor operates at a base clock frequency of 2.0 GHz. The virtual instance is paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

The VM.Standard.E2.4 shape does not include integrated local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system installations. It also operates without hardware acceleration, having zero dedicated GPUs. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated AMD core assignment provides predictable execution without contention from shared-core virtualization overhead.

Offering an industry-standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, VM.Standard.E2.4 balances processing capability and system memory for routine enterprise operations. It is suited for general-purpose workloads, including standard web serving, application middleware, microservices deployment, ETL processes, and continuous integration pipelines that do not demand high per-core clock frequencies or onboard low-latency storage.
